ModMetaData.name: RimMT V0.9.2 Unified Lean
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Single-DLL production build for RimWorld 1.5. Consolidates the validated RimMT scheduler/dispatcher, JobGiver nearest-first and package-local search-plan reuse, S5.1 Hybrid Tail Rescue at the validated 16ms admission point, RC2 large-set early-tail prevention, rolling-fuse ReachProfile, persistent low-churn DoBill indexing, mature S5.3 BuildRoof/Harvest/ClearSnow pruning with Tend/Sow fail-closed compatibility, production haul accelerators, path-topology invalidation, and the validated Common Sense ingredient-expansion memo. Resident hot-path diagnostics, PathSnapshot shadow validation, WorkPrefilter and low-yield Stage4D experiments are excluded from the production path and may be supplied as optional external diagnostics.
